Curly apostrophes in The Reaper’s Right Hand, Roderic’s Cove and Roslar’s Coffer, with wording, and all contributor names and terminal periods are retained. No product-code alias or complete book notice chain is established.

The End of Eternity and The Impossible Eye literally use Copyright 2009; The Final Wish and Bastards of Erebus use © 2009. All four use Paizo Publishing, LLC; Author:; and terminal periods. Sean K Reynolds is retained without adding punctuation. No date or wording correction is inferred.

The Sixfold Trial variants retain the same 2009 copyright date and Richard Pett contributor, but differ in Pathfinder versus Pathfinder Adventure Path # title wording, Copyright versus ©, and absent versus present terminal period. Both literal notices remain separate without inferred aliases.

What Lies in Dust variants retain the same 2009 copyright date and Michael Kortes contributor, but differ in Pathfinder versus Pathfinder Adventure Path # title wording, Copyright versus ©, and absent versus present terminal period. Both literal notices remain separate without inferred aliases.

The Infernal Syndrome variants retain the same 2009 copyright date and Clinton Boomer and James Jacobs contributors, but differ in Pathfinder versus Pathfinder Adventure Path # title wording, Copyright versus ©, Author: versus Authors:, and absent versus present terminal period. Both literal notices remain separate without inferred aliases.
